title: Caption pipeline provenance manifest template
purpose: Machine-readable template for recording the exact revision of each component in the ACE-Step Studio caption pipeline (aligner → words_to_ass converter → quantization adapter → player). Enables a future agent or operator to reconstruct what was active when a caption failure occurred. Companion to artifact 15a27d97 (ASS timing adapter). Not an execution record; fill in fields at runtime.
execution: See separate execution receipts; publication alone is not a passed test.
